parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0019). Clients MUST always send a non-empty, unique-per-submit key: the header is required whenever the service runs with Postgres — i.e. in every deployment — and an absent or empty key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`. A replay with the same key and the same body returns the original response verbatim; the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`. It is declared `required: false` here only because the in-memory development mode (no DATABASE_URL) does not enforce the middleware and the Schemathesis contract run boots that mode.
